description:
This Python workflow verifies one published training instance in each of the five app difficulty tiers of Cube Sudoku Benchmark v1.0.0. It checks the CPMpy model against the published topology of 386 unique cells and 150 distinct Sudoku constraints. Using OR-Tools CP-SAT, it checks each solution against the released reference and tests uniqueness by ruling out that solution and checking that no other solution exists.

With Python 3.12, install the pinned dependencies using `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt` and run `python verify_examples.py` from the repository root. The code is licensed under Apache-2.0. The five sample instances and topology are licensed under CC BY 4.0.

[Dataset methodology](https://www.dream-factory.app/cubesudoku/en/datasets) · [Full dataset on Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24342566)
name: Cube Sudoku Benchmark – Solver Verification
